title: Payment API returning HTTP 500
description: The payment service is reachable, but customer payment requests fail with HTTP 500.
environment: payment-api v3.2, PostgreSQL backend, connection pool size 100
verification: Payment API health check returns HTTP 200 and a test payment request succeeds.

title: Customer database unavailable
description: Applications cannot connect to the customer database.
verification: Database health check is healthy and a SELECT 1 query succeeds.

title: Production server CPU at 98 percent
description: CPU utilization has remained above 95 percent for more than 10 minutes and requests are slowing down.
root_cause: Worker service thread exhaustion causing sustained CPU saturation
verification: CPU falls below 80 percent and response latency returns below 1 second.

title: Server disk space almost full
description: The application server is reporting low disk capacity and logs show write failures.
logs: 16:02:05 application log write failed: no space left
root_cause: Runaway application log growth consumed disk capacity
verification: Disk usage falls below 80 percent and application logging succeeds.

title: Users cannot log in
description: Valid users receive authentication errors while attempting to sign in.
verification: A test user can authenticate successfully and receives a valid access token.

title: Internal API timeout
description: Service A times out when calling Service B.
environment: Internal Kubernetes network, service-b healthy according to local process status
root_cause: Broken service route between service-a and service-b
verification: Service A successfully receives a response from Service B within 500ms.
